quotes.author: Keith
quotes.text: What a BLAST! " We have gone parasailing before in Siesta Key but we just used Parasail Siesta for our trip and it was awazing. Kizza, Max and Dylan were great. They were obviously experts at what they do but were also fun and informative about thr area. We will be using Parasail Siesta next year FOR SURE!!!

quotes.author: Rodney H
quotes.text: Great Parasailing Experience! " Went out with Kizza and Ricky who were very knowledgeable and engaging. The boat and equipment looked well maintained and everyone had a great time. The guys even took time to get dolphins to play in the wake of the boat on our way back to the dock. Thanks for a great day.

quotes.author: Brittany Wilkinson
quotes.text: Captain Max and Andrew took our family of 7 out on a random adventure and had the most amazing time. Andrew was amazing with our 3 children and we couldn’t have had a better experience. We had one that was terrified to fly but they were able to make jokes and make them comfortable. Great time onboard.

quotes.author: Ljaranda
quotes.text: Best Part of our Vacation! " Great customer service, friendly boat staff. First time for our girls and they felt safe the entire trip. Trip was about 2 hours (12 minute para-sail ride). Bring towels and sunscreen as there is no cover on the boat. Nice site seeing trip on the boat to/from site.

quotes.author: Tiffany Wilson
quotes.text: This was very scary being afraid of heights but it was worth every 13 mins in the sky. Max and Andrew had us laughing and safe the whole trip. Thank you for this experience. I would definitely do this again and recommend. Thanks for the sky wedgie 😊😊😂❤️

quotes.author: Carsyn Melander
quotes.text: Captain Max and Andrew were incredibly kind and funny! The experience was fantastic; we even got to see dolphins. I highly recommend coming to this place for parasailing.

quotes.author: Autumn Melander
quotes.text: Had a GREAT TIME! An amazing experience with Captain Matt and Andrew! We saw dolphins as we went out! Was a perfect amount of time! We had a BLAST!!!

quotes.author: Sudhan
quotes.text: Best part of our Siesta trip " The gracious and informative office staff, the super efficient parasailing team and the stellar boats made our family very relaxed and happy that we were about to take our first parasailing trip. The ethereal experience above, at sunset time that followed, just made it the highlight of the trip. One of our friends who went recently after us also found the team and experience simply superb. Thank you Terry, Nicole, Eric and Savannah and wish you a very happy new year ahead !
